caption: The drawing depicts a single standing figure positioned on a green rectangular pedestal. The figure has medium brown skin and long black hair that reaches past the shoulders. The individual is dressed in a short red tunic with fringed yellow trim at the hem and sleeves, and a V-shaped blue-green collar with a round gold medallion at the center of the chest. There is an additional yellow belt around the waist and a short cape or shawl in muted gold/yellow draped over the shoulders and hanging down behind. Two green feather-shaped ornaments are attached to the waist belt. The figure wears red socks, black shoes with a strap, and a gold armband on the left arm. The head is adorned with a brown headband that holds three upright feathers colored blue, red, and green. In the right hand, the figure holds a brown object resembling a bunch of leaves or a fringed pouch, and in the left, an angular brown object resembling a book or a box. The background is plain and off-white. The name "Eugene Croe" is written in the lower right corner in light purple script.
title: Cigar Store Indian
